title: NVlabs/ProtoMotions
summary: ProtoMotions provides a GPU-accelerated simulation and learning stack for training physically simulated digital humans and humanoid robots. It is aimed at scalable motion-learning experiments where researchers need fast physics simulation tied directly to policy training, rather than a standalone animation or robotics demo.

extra.full_text: ProtoMotions is a GPU-accelerated simulation and learning framework for training physically simulated digital humans and humanoid robots.

title: sou350121/VLA-Handbook
summary: VLA-Handbook is a Chinese, practice-oriented learning and interview guide for algorithm engineers entering Vision-Language-Action work in robotics. It narrows the usual CV/NLP preparation lens toward robotics-specific issues, making it useful as a field primer for people who need to understand how perception, language, and action models are discussed and evaluated in robot systems.

extra.full_text: 本项目旨在为致力于进入VLA(Vision-Language-Action)领域的算法工程师提供一份全中文、实战导向的学习/面试手册。  不同于通用的 CV/NLP 面试指南，本项目聚焦于 Robotics 特有的挑战

title: DravenALG/awesome-vla-wam
summary: DravenALG/awesome-vla-wam is a curated reading list for vision-language-action models and world action models, collecting research around systems that connect perception, language, planning, and robot control. It is useful as a map of the rapidly growing VLA/WAM area rather than a runnable tool, helping researchers track relevant papers, methods, and adjacent resources in one place.

extra.full_text: A Curated List of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World Action Models (WAM) Research and Beyond

title: google-deepmind/mujoco_playground
summary: google-deepmind/mujoco_playground is an open-source library for training robot policies with GPU-accelerated MuJoCo simulation. It is aimed at robot learning workflows where fast simulation and sim-to-real transfer matter, giving researchers a shared playground for developing and testing policies before moving them onto hardware.

extra.full_text: An open-source library for GPU-accelerated robot learning and sim-to-real transfer.

summary: Isaac Lab API, powered by MuJoCo-Warp, for RL and robotics research

extra.full_text: Isaac Lab API, powered by MuJoCo-Warp, for RL and robotics research

title: NVIDIA/warp
summary: NVIDIA Warp is a Python framework for writing GPU-accelerated simulation code aimed at robotics, physics, graphics, and machine learning workflows. It is useful when researchers need differentiable or high-performance simulation kernels that integrate with Python while still running efficiently on NVIDIA GPUs.

extra.full_text: A Python framework for GPU-accelerated simulation, robotics, and machine learning.

title: RobotControlStack/robot-control-stack
summary: RobotControlStack is a lightweight sim-to-real stack for training and deploying Vision-Language-Action models and reinforcement learning agents without depending on ROS. It provides native MuJoCo Gymnasium wrappers with synchronous execution across several robot platforms, including Franka, UR5e, xArm, SO101, and YAM, making it useful for researchers who want a tighter, more direct path from simulation experiments to real robot control.

extra.full_text: A lean, ROS-free sim-to-real framework for training and deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and RL agents. Native MuJoCo Gymnasium wrappers with synchronous execution for Franka, UR5e, xArm, SO101 and YAM.

title: isaac-sim/IsaacLab-Arena
summary: IsaacLab-Arena extends NVIDIA Isaac Lab with a composable setup for building robotics simulation environments and evaluating learned robot policies across different embodiments, objects, and scenes. It is aimed at fast prototyping and scalable testing, making it useful when researchers need to compare task designs or policy behavior without rebuilding simulation infrastructure each time.

extra.full_text: Isaac Lab - Arena is a robotics simulation framework that enhances NVIDIA Isaac Lab by providing a composable, scalable system for creating diverse simulation environments and evaluating robot learning policies. The framework enables developers to rapidly prototype and test robotic tasks with various robot embodiments, objects, and environments.

title: ROBOTIS-GIT/cyclo_lab
summary: ROBOTIS-GIT/cyclo_lab collects hands-on tutorials for training reinforcement learning and imitation learning policies on ROBOTIS robot platforms. Its practical value is in the Sim2Real path: users can learn policies in simulation and deploy them onto real robots, making it useful as a bridge between robot learning experiments and hardware execution.

extra.full_text: This repository provides tutorials for reinforcement learning and imitation learning using ROBOTIS robots, and supports Sim2Real functionality for deploying the learned policies on real robots.

title: iit-DLSLab/basic-locomotion-isaaclab
summary: An IsaacLab DirectEnv implementation for basic quadruped locomotion, aimed at training and testing policies across multiple robot platforms. It is useful as a starting point for sim-to-sim and sim-to-real locomotion pipelines, rather than a standalone benchmark or paper result.

extra.full_text: An IsaacLab DirectEnv for basic quadrupedal locomotion tasks, with support for multiple quadruped robots, sim-to-sim, and sim-to-real pipelines

title: RoboVerseOrg/RoboVerse
summary: RoboVerse aims to package robot learning into a unified stack: a platform, dataset, and benchmark for training and evaluating policies at scale. The emphasis is on making robot learning more generalizable across settings, giving researchers a common environment to build on rather than stitching together separate simulators, data formats, and evaluation protocols.

extra.full_text: RoboVerse: Towards a Unified Platform, Dataset and Benchmark for Scalable and Generalizable Robot Learning

title: dartsim/dart
summary: DART is a research-oriented C++23 physics engine for simulating articulated robots, character animation, and learning systems, with Python bindings for easier integration into ML workflows. It is likely most useful when researchers need a controllable dynamics simulator that can sit close to robotics algorithms while still supporting animation and machine-learning experiments.

extra.full_text: Research-focused C++23 physics engine for robotics, animation, and machine learning, with Python bindings

title: flexivrobotics/isaac_sim_ws
summary: Flexiv’s Isaac Sim workspace adds Flexiv robot models to NVIDIA Isaac Sim and lets them be driven through the same interfaces used on hardware: Flexiv Elements Studio or the Flexiv RDK. The useful bit is that simulation can run against the actual force/torque controller from the real robots, making it a practical setup for testing control workflows before moving to physical Flexiv arms.

extra.full_text: Add Flexiv robots to Isaac Sim and control them using Flexiv Elements Studio or Flexiv RDK with the actual force/torque controller used on real robots.

title: DeepRoboticsLab/sdk_deploy
summary: DeepRoboticsLab/sdk_deploy provides sim-to-sim and sim-to-real deployment support for Deep Robotics quadrupeds, currently the M20 and Lite3. It is useful for moving robot control policies or simulation-tested behaviors toward hardware through the vendor SDK path, with a focus on deployment rather than training or benchmarking.

extra.full_text: Sim-to-sim and sim-to-real deployment for Deep Robotics Robots, currently supporting M20 and Lite3

title: D-Robotics/hobot_stereonet
summary: Hobot StereoNet is D-Robotics’ deep learning stereo depth estimator, taking paired left/right camera images and producing dense depth maps in real time. It is aimed at robotics and computer vision systems that need fast 3D perception from stereo cameras rather than heavier or more specialized depth sensors.

extra.full_text: Hobot StereoNet is a high-performance, deep learning-based stereo depth estimation algorithm developed by D-Robotics. It processes stereo image pairs to generate accurate depth maps in real-time, enabling 3D perception for robotics and computer vision applications.

title: castacks/AirStack
summary: AirStack is an agent-native field-robotics framework built around a closed-loop sim-to-real workflow that mirrors the hardware one-to-one and includes self-validation. It is meant to speed up deployment of embodied AI on real robotic systems by keeping simulation, hardware behavior, and validation tightly aligned, with the develop branch carrying the newest features.

extra.full_text: Agent-native framework for rapid sim-to-real deployment of embodied AI for field robotics. Closed-loop, one-to-one workflow with hardware, self validating. Checkout develop branch for latest features.

title: GlimmerLab/Awesome-Embodied-AI-Robot
summary: RoboLLM Hub is a curated index of embodied AI and robot learning resources, collecting papers, code, tools, and related materials in one place. It is useful as a discovery surface for researchers tracking robot learning and embodied intelligence work, especially when scanning for recent methods and implementations across the field.

title: MINT-SJTU/Evo-1
summary: Evo-1 is a lightweight vision-language-action model focused on keeping semantic alignment intact while mapping visual and language inputs to robot actions. The repo appears to be for researchers or builders who want a smaller VLA model that preserves the connection between high-level meaning and low-level control, but the provided text does not include benchmarks, datasets, or quantitative results.

extra.full_text: Evo-1: Lightweight Vision-Language-Action Model with Preserved Semantic Alignment

title: open-edge-platform/physical-ai-studio
summary: Physical AI Studio provides an end-to-end pipeline for teaching robots from human demonstrations using imitation learning. It is aimed at the practical loop of collecting demonstrations, training policies, and deploying task behavior, making it useful for teams building physical AI systems rather than just experimenting with isolated robot-learning components.

extra.full_text: Physical AI Studio is an end-to-end framework for training robots to perform tasks through imitation learning from human demonstrations.

title: kuds/mesozoic-labs
summary: kuds/mesozoic-labs is an open-source platform for studying dinosaur biomechanics through MuJoCo-based Gymnasium environments, with reinforcement learning used to train locomotion behaviors. It combines curriculum learning and W&B experiment tracking to support iterative training studies, and it is aimed at sim-to-real transfer toward physical robotic locomotion inspired by prehistoric animals.

extra.full_text: Open-source research platform for dinosaur biomechanics and robotic locomotion using reinforcement learning. MuJoCo-based Gymnasium environments with curriculum learning, W&B experiment tracking, and sim-to-real transfer goals.

title: EGalahad/mimic-lite
summary: mimic-lite targets efficient whole-body motion tracking for humanoids, with an emphasis on making training scalable and keeping the learned behavior deployable from simulation to real hardware. It appears aimed at researchers who need a lightweight motion imitation stack for humanoid control rather than a heavyweight full-system pipeline.

extra.full_text: Efficient humanoid whole-body motion tracking for scalable training and sim-to-real deployment.

title: chang-xinhai/Awesome-Dexterous-Manipulation
summary: Curated index of resources for dexterous robot manipulation, spanning tactile sensing, multi-finger hands, robot learning methods, datasets, benchmarks, and simulators. It is useful as a navigation map for researchers entering the area or tracking related work across hardware, perception, control, and evaluation resources.

extra.full_text: A curated awesome list for dexterous robot manipulation, tactile sensing, dexterous hands, robot learning, datasets, benchmarks, and simulators.

title: martin-sedlacek/REALM
summary: REALM is an IEEE RA-L 2026 benchmark for testing how well robotic manipulation policies generalize when trained or evaluated across real and simulated settings. Its focus is real-to-sim validation, giving researchers a way to separate methods that merely fit a particular setup from those that transfer more robustly across manipulation scenarios.

extra.full_text: [IEEE RA-L 2026] REALM: A Real-to-Sim Validated Benchmark for Generalization in Robotic Manipulation
